title: Funny things that happens on experiment.

posts.author: Jack the Stripper
posts.title: Funny things that happens on experiment.
posts.html:
What's the funniest thing that ever happened to you on experiment?

I guess the funnyest thing that ever happened to me was when I was beating a guy up with a crowbar inside a room, and he complains about me breaking NLR.
Syff comes in in noclip, looks around and says "there is no new life rule...*Evil voice* Enjoy!"

posts.author: Snake Assault
posts.html:
Well, when it was still kuro, me and three friends had tiny clan. We were all LP members RPing a Aperture science bots, there to watch the "experiment."
We also got to use HEV suit cases for beds. It was epic. And then the server shut down from Kuro and we all abandoned ship.

posts.author: patatkraam
posts.html:
I remember some event, i think it was with NewLife.

We found some guy in the nexus cell blocks, so we went to check. ( our base was 1 floor above. )
After we came down there, the guy make all his drug creators and was hiding in a cel with them.. so we wanted to get inside and he was blocking the door, we eventually shot him, destroyed his stuff, and he started to whine about NLR even though it was the first time we met him.. kindof fun..

And ofcourse you got the burning barrel stories.
